hazards.description: The sidewalk is narrow and directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or parked cars visible to provide a safety buffer from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Metal pole obstruction
hazards.description: A metal pole base or bollard is located at the edge of the sidewalk, which could be a trip hazard or obstruction for pedestrians with visual impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left and bottom right foreground

hazards.name: Encroaching steps
hazards.description: Residential steps protrude into the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the clear path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no protected space and must walk in the vehicle travel or parking area.

hazards.name: Poor road surface
hazards.description: The asphalt is cracked and uneven, creating potential trip hazards for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the intersection ahead, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked pavement.

hazards.name: Litter and Debris
hazards.description: Accumulated trash along the fence line creates a tripping hazard and indicates neglect.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the base of the chain-link fence.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long blank wall and vacant lot reduce eyes on the street, which can compromise personal safety for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway with Vehicle Encroachment
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is narrow and further restricted by the overhang of parked vehicles.
